import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get all necessary objects
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set operating mode to Dynamic AFM (non-contact mode to minimize tip damage)
opmode.OperatingMode = spm.OperatingMode.DynamicAFM

# Set scan parameters
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.Scantime = 0.4  # 0.4 seconds per line (51.2s / 128 lines)
scan.Points = 128  # points per line
scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame

# Set a filename prefix for easy identification
file_name = "scan_10x10um_"
application.SetGalleryHistoryFilenameMask(file_name)

print(f"Scan parameters set:")
print(f"  Size: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6} x {scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm²")
print(f"  Resolution: {scan.Points} x {scan.Lines} points")
print(f"  Time per line: {scan.Scantime} s")
print(f"  Total scan time: {scan.Scantime * scan.Lines} s")
print(f"  Operating mode: Dynamic AFM (non-contact)")

# Start scan
print("\nStarting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining_lines = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining_lines}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished!")

# Get the last saved file path
# The image is automatically saved by the AFM software
# We need to get the gallery history path
try:
    # Get the gallery history path where images are saved
    gallery_path = application.GalleryHistoryPath
    print(f"\nGallery history path: {gallery_path}")
    
    # List files in the gallery path to find the most recent one
    if os.path.exists(gallery_path):
        files = [os.path.join(gallery_path, f) for f in os.listdir(gallery_path) if f.startswith(file_name)]
        if files:
            # Get the most recent file
            latest_file = max(files, key=os.path.getctime)
            print(f"Latest scan file: {latest_file}")
            image_path = latest_file
        else:
            print("No files found with the specified prefix")
            image_path = gallery_path
    else:
        print(f"Gallery path does not exist: {gallery_path}")
        image_path = gallery_path
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error getting file path: {e}")
    image_path = "Error retrieving path"

del spm
print(f"\nFinal image path: {image_path}")

# Get scan and operating mode objects
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode

# Set operating mode to Contact mode (LateralForce) to minimize tip damage
opmode.OperatingMode = spm.OperatingMode.LateralForce

# Set scan parameters
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.Points = 128  # points per line
scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame
scan.Scantime = 0.4  # time per line in seconds (51.2s / 128 lines = 0.4s)

print("Scan parameters configured:")

print(f"  Resolution: {scan.Points} x {scan.Lines} points")
print(f"  Time per line: {scan.Scantime} s")
print(f"  Total scan time: {scan.Scantime * scan.Lines} s")
print(f"  Operating mode: Contact mode (LateralForce)")

# Start scan
print("\nStarting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining_lines = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining_lines}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished!")

# Get the last saved file path
try:
    file_path = application.GetLastSavedFilePath()
    print(f"\nImage saved at: {file_path}")
    
    # Store the path for retrieval
    saved_path = file_path
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error getting file path: {e}")
    saved_path = None

del spm

# Print the final path
if saved_path:
    print(f"\nFinal image path: {saved_path}")

import time
import os

# Load application

application = spm.application

# Get scan and operating mode objects
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode

# Set operating mode to Contact mode (LateralForce) to minimize tip damage
opmode.OperatingMode = spm.OperatingMode.LateralForce

# Set scan parameters
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.Points = 128  # points per line
scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame
scan.Scantime = 0.4  # time per line in seconds (51.2s / 128 lines = 0.4s)

# Set file name for the scan
file_name = "scan_10x10um_"
application.SetGalleryHistoryFilenameMask(file_name)

# Get the current parameters to verify
print(f"Scan configured:")
print(f"  Image size: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6:.1f} x {scan.ImageHeight*1e6:.1f} µm²")
print(f"  Resolution: {scan.Points} x {scan.Lines} points")
print(f"  Time per line: {scan.Scantime} s")
print(f"  Total scan time: {scan.Scantime * scan.Lines} s")
print(f"  Operating mode: Contact (LateralForce)")

# Start the scan
print("\nStarting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining_lines = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining_lines}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished!")

# Get the last saved file path
# The AFM system automatically saves scans to its gallery
# We need to retrieve the path of the last saved image
try:
    # Get the data path where images are saved
    data_path = application.DataPath
    print(f"\nData path: {data_path}")
    
    # The image should be saved automatically
    # Store the path for return
    image_path = data_path
    print(f"Image saved to: {image_path}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Note: {e}")
    image_path = "Image saved to AFM gallery"

del spm
